caption: Sample size, observed zeros and positive-rainfall quantiles. Zero observations are real measurements; missing records are absent.
Positive observations only; logarithmic bin widths. Large recorded values are retained, not automatically validated or rejected.
All 96 calendar combinations. In (a), inactive stations are excluded from the median; in (b), grey means no qualified stations.
Raw and cleaned daily counts distinguish a source gap from cleaning losses. Calendar days with zero records remain visible.
Observed monthly station totals averaged across qualified stations. Composition varies; grey is insufficient data, never zero rainfall.
Equal eligible-year means; shading is the observed range, not a confidence interval. Month lengths, stations and available years differ.
Each month is compared across all eight years; gaps break lines. Each small panel has its own vertical range; use the heatmap for magnitude comparisons.
Dots are eligible station-year totals; diamonds are station means. Annual ≥95% and every month ≥90% coverage are required. No line bridges unsupported years.
Adjacent-year comparison at the same calendar month using common stable-location stations. Changes with fewer than five common stations are not displayed; each pair has a different panel.
Adjacent-year comparison at the same calendar month using common stable-location stations. Changes with fewer than five common stations are not displayed; each pair has a different panel.
Observed-interval-weighted wet frequencies using all eligible station-months. Available months and station composition differ between years.
Eligible station-months and ≥95% complete station-days. Approximate quantiles include dry days; a wet day has an observed total >0.
Seasonal results rerun at 80%, 90% and 95% monthly coverage. The sample changes with the threshold; this is robustness evidence, not missing-data recovery.
